# CANDIDATE: OR_VWAP_REJECTION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY opens above the opening range (OR) high, fails to sustain momentum, and reverses into the OR closing below its VWAP with elevated volume, a short-term mean-reversion edge exists. This reflects trapped buyers from the gap-up who exit on weakness, creating intraday selling pressure that reverts price toward the VWAP as fair value. The edge is strongest in higher volatility (VIX>18) and early session when OR definition is most relevant.

## Mechanism

**Entry trigger (all must be true on the same 30-minute bar):**
1. Open price > OR_high (OR defined as first 30-minute bar high from 09:30-10:00 ET)
2. Price at any time after open reaches OR_low OR lower (OR_low = first 30-minute bar low)
3. That 30-minute bar's closing price < OR_VWAP (volume-weighted average price of the OR period)
4. Volume of that bar > 1.3x average volume of the prior 5 thirty-minute bars
Enter short at the close of the triggering 30-minute bar.

**Exit logic:**
- **Stop:** Chart-stop at OR_high (exit if any subsequent 30-minute bar closes above OR_high)
- **TP1:** Exit 1/3 of position at 1R profit (where R = entry price - OR_high for shorts; i.e., profit target = entry - (OR_high - entry))
- **Runner:** Trail stop at 10% below highest price reached since entry (HWM) for remaining 2/3 position
- **Time stop:** All positions closed by 15:50 ET

Regime filters (applied contextually but not in core trigger):
- Only consider trades when VIX > 18
- Only consider triggers occurring in first 90 minutes of session (09:30-11:00 ET)

5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Strong gap-up continuation triggers stop at OR_high for -1R loss
   - Max drawdown: Consecutive losses in persistent uptrend regime (e.g., multiple gap-up days)
   - Blow-up scenario: Strategy exposed to gap-and-go days without adequate vol filtering; catastrophic if VIX filter fails during low-vol breakout
